rationale:
OWNER RULING 2026-08-19, on a choice this lane put to him after bugs_closed/302: route dark_section_audit to a handler that can actually make these changes. This is the implementation. The gate work in 302 stopped the platform PRETENDING these were repaired; it repaired nothing, and the constitution seat said so at the time — 'it does not fix the routing/capability mismatch'. This does.

WHY THE OLD ROUTE COULD NEVER WORK, measured rather than argued. The findings ask for SCOPED CSS BLOCKS DEFINING SECTION TOKENS: the live suggestions read 'add a scoped style block for .cta-section that defines --section-text: #ffffff; --section-text-muted: ...' and 'add a .site-footer scoped block defining --section-text, --section-heading, --section-surface and --section-bg'. That is an additive stylesheet rule. color-variable-fixer's transform (checks.ReplaceHardcodedColors) rewrites dark hex literals INSIDE component bodies and its entire output alphabet is var(--color-primary)/var(--color-secondary). [MEASURED, archive-inclusive] all 26 completions across 17 sites reported a repair count of ZERO and not one ever reported a non-zero fix.

WHY css-patch-agent. Its workflow is literally this job — load_current_css -> plan_css_fix -> save_css_to_db -> deploy_css — and it already carries the sibling colour concern (contrast_failure, 287 items). Capability confirmed AT THE ARTEFACT rather than from its config: 39 of its completions carry a git-adapter response deploying assets/css/styles.css, most recent 2026-08-18.

WHY NOT webdesign-agent, which takes every other colour category and would have been the consistency-argument choice: for its main type (needs_design_review) the owner ruled the same day that THE ANALYSIS IS THE DELIVERABLE, and [MEASURED] all 1,268 of its completions carry no response envelope at all. Routing a repair need at an analysis producer is the mistake being fixed, in different clothes.

THE RISK I AM MOST EXPOSED ON, stated first rather than left for a seat to find: css-patch-agent has an OPEN bug of its own — bugs_open/198, where it persisted an LLM fragment as the WHOLE stylesheet and a live site served a 149-byte styles.css. I am routing more work at it anyway, and here is the basis: its candidate-1 guard is live (migration 318, applied and verified) and its candidate-3 guard is live at the pod (chassis v1.0.1277, pod-grepped on both replicas 2026-08-10), and that bug's own last note says only the witnessed run keeps it open. Since those guards landed it has completed 98 items with 39 artefact-verified stylesheet deploys and no recurrence. If a seat judges that insufficient, the honest alternative is to hold this routing change until 198's witnessed run lands — which costs nothing today, because both carriers for this type are enabled=false and the route is INERT.

BLAST RADIUS. designRouting is read at FILING time only, so this cannot re-route a single existing row; 30 rows keep their handler_agent and all 30 are already terminal. Both carriers are off (owner decision 2, same day: keep them off for now), so nothing will be filed through this route until that is revisited.

WHAT THIS CHANGE DELIBERATELY DOES NOT DO, and the precondition it creates. Gate 1b's roster entry for dark_section_audit is licensed by a measurement about color-variable-fixer, and this line VOIDS that licence: the CounterPaths name counters css-patch-agent does not emit (its shape is css_fix/css_deployed, and 56 of 103 completions carry no response envelope at all — no numeric counter exists in it), so the block arm is dead and every payload would read as unreadable. I have NOT rewritten that entry, because I cannot write a justified one: css-patch-agent has never handled this type, so any CounterPaths I invented would be the guess about somebody else's handler that the roster explicitly forbids. It is left in place because its failure direction is a REFUSAL — safe, non-destructive, routed to human review — and removing it instead would drop the type out of the claim-timeout exclusion list (WII-021 asserts excluded <-> gated), reversing a live change to no benefit while there is no traffic. The precondition is recorded at BOTH sites in code: before a carrier is re-enabled, re-measure and rewrite the entry, or delete it together with its exclusion row.

plan.summary: Route the dark_section design-audit category to css-patch-agent, which can write the scoped CSS the findings ask for, instead of color-variable-fixer, whose transform provably cannot — and record at both sites that gate 1b's roster entry for the type is thereby unlicensed until re-measured.
